questions.question: In Windows operating systems, which command entered into the Command Prompt (`cmd`) displays the computer's current IP address configuration?

answerOptions.rationale: Executing `ipconfig` displays active network adapter details, including IP addressing information.
The `ping` command checks connectivity and latency to a target host rather than displaying local adapter configurations.
The `netstat` command lists active network connections and ports rather than device IP configurations.
The `traceroute` command tracks network path hops to a destination rather than printing local network interface properties.

questions.hint: Think about the command line tool specifically used to configure and view local IP properties in Windows.

questions.question: Which two IP address standards are used for internet network addressing according to the textbook material?

answerOptions.rationale: IPv4 and IPv6 are the coexisting internet protocol addressing standards referenced in the text.
IPv2 was an early developmental protocol and is not a current internet addressing standard.
IPv5 was an experimental streaming protocol rather than a standard addressing format for internet hosts.
IPv8 is not an established addressing standard used on the global internet.

questions.hint: Identify the standard address system currently in wide use alongside its newer expanded version.

questions.question: What is the correct navigation path within the Windows OS Settings app to check your computer's IP address and network properties?

answerOptions.rationale: Accessing Properties under Ethernet within Network & Internet displays active network parameters and IP address info.
Display settings manage monitor parameters rather than network adapter addresses.

answerOptions.text: Settings > Devices > Printers & Scanners > Hardware Properties
answerOptions.rationale: Printers & Scanners settings handle peripheral device setup rather than local network adapter parameters.

answerOptions.text: Settings > Privacy & Security > Developer Mode > Network Logs
answerOptions.rationale: Developer permissions do not serve as the primary location for viewing standard network adapter configuration properties.

questions.hint: Focus on the menu category directly responsible for wired network interface connections.

questions.question: Which sensor should be selected for a physical computing project if the goal is to measure environmental brightness?

answerOptions.rationale: Illuminance (조도) sensors detect ambient light levels in the surrounding area.
Motion sensors detect physical movement of objects or living beings rather than light levels.
Tilt sensors evaluate inclination or tilt angles relative to gravity.
Distance sensors calculate spatial separation rather than ambient light intensity.

questions.hint: Look for the sensor specifically named after detecting light levels.

questions.question: Which sensor uses ultrasonic waves to determine how far away an object is located?

answerOptions.rationale: Ultrasonic distance sensors transmit and receive high-frequency sound waves to measure distance to targets.
Laser sensors measure range using light beams rather than sound waves.
Touch sensors register direct physical surface contact rather than measuring distant spatial intervals using sound.
Tilt sensors monitor angular orientation rather than measuring linear proximity via acoustic signals.

questions.hint: Recall which sensor relies on reflected sound pulses to calculate spatial gaps.

questions.question: How does resource sharing through cloud computing differ fundamentally from local personal computer sharing?

answerOptions.text: Cloud computing allows users to access software and data hosted on remote servers from any location via a network connection.
answerOptions.rationale: Cloud computing centralizes software execution and storage on network servers, bypassing local hardware dependencies.

answerOptions.text: Local personal computer sharing allows remote users to access files even when the host PC is powered off.
answerOptions.rationale: Local file sharing requires the physical host computer to remain turned on and connected.

answerOptions.text: Cloud computing requires direct physical cable connections between user devices and central storage drives.
answerOptions.rationale: Cloud systems utilize internet connectivity rather than direct local cable attachments.

answerOptions.text: Local personal computer sharing automatically publishes files to the public internet without permission management.
answerOptions.rationale: Local PC sharing relies on designated shared folders and local access permission settings.

questions.hint: Consider where the data is stored and software is run when using cloud resources compared to desktop setups.

questions.question: Which sensor is best suited for registering when a person physically contacts or presses a specific control area on a device?

answerOptions.rationale: Touch sensors detect physical contact on a surface to send input signals to a computing system.
Motion sensors detect movement through a space rather than direct contact on a localized control surface.
Laser sensors project light to gauge range or velocity without requiring direct surface contact.
Temperature and humidity sensors monitor atmospheric variables rather than direct contact interactions.

questions.hint: Identify the sensor designed specifically to respond to physical contact.

questions.question: Which of the following best describes the core concept of the Internet of Things (IoT)?

answerOptions.text: A network environment where everyday physical objects equipped with sensors and communication hardware exchange data with other devices or humans.
answerOptions.rationale: IoT integrates everyday items into network structures, enabling intelligent data exchange and physical computing interaction.

answerOptions.text: A local cable connection connecting personal computers and local printers within a single office room.
answerOptions.rationale: Connecting computers and printers locally describes a conventional LAN, not the broader IoT paradigm.

answerOptions.text: A web browser search tool used exclusively to look up a device's public IP address.
answerOptions.rationale: Searching for IP information is a general user diagnostic action, not an embedded IoT architecture.

answerOptions.text: A specialized wireless protocol used strictly to project audio from smartphones to speakers.
answerOptions.rationale: Audio streaming is a specific media utility rather than the comprehensive concept of connected smart objects.

questions.hint: Look for the definition emphasizing everyday objects fitted with sensors and communication modules sharing data.

questions.question: When screen mirroring a smartphone to a classroom TV screen, what display change occurs when rotating the smartphone from portrait to landscape mode?

answerOptions.text: The mirrored image on the TV changes its display size and allows full-screen viewing.
answerOptions.rationale: Matching the horizontal aspect ratio of widescreen TVs enables full-screen projection.

answerOptions.text: The network connection terminates and prompts for a security password.
answerOptions.rationale: Changing screen orientation does not disconnect active wireless networking sessions.

answerOptions.text: The underlying transmission method automatically switches from Wi-Fi to Bluetooth.
answerOptions.rationale: Device rotation affects frame dimensions without changing active wireless protocols.

answerOptions.text: The screen resolution drops permanently to prevent audio-visual sync errors.
answerOptions.rationale: Orientation adjustments reframe the content rather than forcing permanent degradation of output resolution.

questions.hint: Think about how aspect ratio adjustments impact widescreen TV displays.

questions.question: In an IoT-based automated fire detection system, what is the role of the computer after a sensor detects smoke or heat?

answerOptions.text: It processes the input signal from the sensor, evaluates the condition, and triggers the alarm output.
answerOptions.rationale: Physical computing workflow follows the cycle of sensor input $\rightarrow$ computer processing/judgment $\rightarrow$ actuator response.

answerOptions.text: It transforms heat energy directly into acoustic output power for the alarm siren.
answerOptions.rationale: Computers process data signals; they do not perform physical energy conversion for speaker drivers.

answerOptions.text: It modifies the computer's network IP address to block incoming connections.
answerOptions.rationale: Changing IP parameters is irrelevant to evaluating sensor input and executing emergency alerts.

answerOptions.text: It disconnects all wireless interfaces to isolate local smart devices.
answerOptions.rationale: IoT systems require active network connectivity to transmit hazard notifications and alerts.

questions.hint: Recall the fundamental sequence of physical computing: sensing input, processing data, and producing an output response.
